acme_customer_ops: Hey @emma_support — after the 2026-03-15 release our agent action is not being executed. The model returns a plain text confirmation instead of invoking the `create_support_ticket` action. Customer is blocked.

acme_customer_ops: Example request id: rw-req-2108882222, variant: v2-quant, rollout: release-2026-03-15 (canary=20%). Model: redwood/infer-8k-v2. SDK: redwood-js@0.11.0.

acme_customer_ops: Minimal repro (JS):
```js
await client.chat.create({
  model: 'redwood/infer-8k-v2',
  input: 'Please create_support_ticket(invoice_id: "INV-12345", priority: "high")',
  function_call: 'auto',
})
```
Response is just text: "Sure — I'll create a ticket for INV-12345." No function/tool call payload.

emma_support: Sorry about that — assigning INC-4521 and escalating to eng-runtime. Can you attach the raw response (headers + body) and the x-rw-request-id? Also send the exact SDK call with headers.

acme_customer_ops: Pasted raw response below (redacted):
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-rw-request-id: rw-req-2108882222
content-type: application/json

{
  "id": "resp-9a2f",
  "model": "redwood/infer-8k-v2",
  "output": [{ "type": "message", "text": "Created ticket for INV-12345. Reference: TKT-9001" }],
  "tool_calls": []
}

acme_customer_ops: We previously got a tool_calls array with name+args. This started after the rollout.

liam_eng_runtime: Thanks @emma_support and @acme_customer_ops — looking. Quick question: did you see streaming behavior or truncation? Also include the "variant-id" header if present.

acme_customer_ops: No streaming. Variant header in request: x-rw-variant: v2-quant.

deploy-bot: deploy event: release-2026-03-15/rc4 applied to infra cluster-a (canary=20%). deploy-id=deploy-2026-03-15-rc4.

liam_eng_runtime: I pulled logs for rw-req-2108882222 — entry shows inference returned "text-only" due to the inference-filter hook marking the action as unsafe under the quantized kernel path. Log snippet: `inference_filter: action_suppressed=true reason=kv-token-mismatch kernel=quant-vq8 variant=v2-quant`.

nina_eng_ml: That matches a change we shipped in the runtime to avoid malformed function payloads when tokenization diverged under vq8 quantization. We added a heuristic to fall back to text-only for certain sequences.

maya_product: Customer impact? Is it limited to certain actions or models/variants?

liam_eng_runtime: Initial triage suggests regression limited to v2-quant and actions that use nested kwargs with colons in the prompt. We need to reproduce locally and test whether the fallback condition is too aggressive.

oncall_sre: If this is customer-facing and blocks workflows, propose rolling back the canary for deploy-2026-03-15-rc4 on cluster-a while we patch. Will coordinate with infra.

emma_support: Customer priority is P1 — they have many invoices to sync. They want a timeline.

liam_eng_runtime: Action items: (1) eng-runtime to create minimal repro showing suppressed action (we'll try the same JS payload and also a raw HTTP POST with content-type application/json; charset=utf-8), (2) eng-ml to review the heuristic and produce a hotpatch that skips suppression for recognized action schemas, (3) oncall to pause canary on cluster-a.

nina_eng_ml: Quick test suggestion: try model variant v1-nq (non-quant) — if tool calls work there, it narrows down to quant-kernel path.

acme_customer_ops: We can test v1-nq if you want. We need a temporary workaround in the meantime (we have hundreds of invoices).

liam_eng_runtime: Temporary workaround: pin the customer's app to variant v1-nq via the API override or ask them to set header `x-rw-variant: v1-nq`. We can provide a signed header rule for them.

emma_support: I'll send instructions and the temp header to the customer and update INC-4521.

liam_eng_runtime: For the reproducer I'll run:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \
  -H 'x-rw-variant: v2-quant' \
  -H 'x-rw-request-id: rw-req-2108882222' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/infer-8k-v2","input":"Please create_support_ticket(invoice_id:\"INV-12345\", priority:\"high\")","function_call":"auto"}'
```
I'll attach logs here once run.

deploy-bot: action: canary_pause deploy-2026-03-15-rc4 cluster-a initiated by oncall_sre.

oncall_sre: Canary paused. Notifying infra ops to hold the remaining rollout.

maya_product: Thanks — please include impact estimate in the incident note and flag any other large customers pinned to v2-quant.

emma_support: Closing loop for now: i've given customer the v1-nq header option and told them we paused the canary. Assigned to eng-runtime/eng-ml to follow up with a patch and validation. Will update INC-4521 with timeline. :thumbsup:
